[NFCT.4.1] Every schema has one lifecycle, which its declaration states and
the artefact carries ([NFCT.1.1]):

- `DS_SCHEMA_LIFECYCLE_LOGICAL` — the fact stays in working memory until it is
  retracted: by your manual retract, by a rule-side retract action, or by the
  engine's truth-maintenance machinery when a logical justifier ends.
  `ttl_ns` is `0`.
- `DS_SCHEMA_LIFECYCLE_TTL` — the fact carries a per-fact deadline
  (`assert_clock + ttl_ns`); the pump's
  TTL sweep retracts it once the deadline passes. `ttl_ns` is `> 0`.
